claim: TUM2TWIN layers are separated into visual reference, semantic/collision geometry and CFD/LBM simulation inputs.
S0 baseline pedestrian layer is dominated by low speed, while the upper layer recovers.
Open-Meteo 2024 weighting is a climate-proxy sensitivity layer, not an annual comfort assessment.
Basic morphology variables are interpretable screening descriptors; sector enclosure ranks above single-building footprint/elongation.
S1/S2 are negative design-sensitivity evidence rather than successful optimization.
Field validation, annual comfort compliance, pollutant dispersion, GCBTE and CityLBM-GH end-to-end execution remain unsupported.
